title: factory-campaign-budget
description: Versioned strict generic campaign/audit budget configuration for the adaptive scheduler authority (Phase 2B2). The trusted scheduler derives every milestone, objective-coverage, no-progress, and terminal decision as a pure function of this committed closed config and the trusted plan/state/outcome inputs — never of model prose. `max_rounds` is the maximum number of planning/implementation/verification/audit cycles (the existing `--rounds` option is a maximum budget, never an exact count; there is no exactly-five rejection); `max_checkpoints` bounds the coherent task checkpoints; `max_wall_seconds` bounds the wall clock (enforced by the existing campaign-timeout authority); `max_task_attempts` bounds the per-task attempts (enforced by the existing task-resource-budget authority); `audit_interval` is the coherent-checkpoint interval at which the independent tester/auditor run; `security_sensitive_paths` are trusted closed-config repository-relative path prefixes that force an independent audit when a checkpoint touches them (never plan prose); `mandatory_audit_objectives` are the audit objective IDs that must all be covered before release success, regardless of checkpoint count; `no_progress_limit` bounds the consecutive identical-audit streak before honest `no_progress` termination. Every field is bounded, the field set is closed (additionalProperties false), duplicate JSON keys are rejected at parse time, and security-sensitive paths reject absolute paths, traversal segments, and glob characters.

max_rounds.description: Maximum number of planning/implementation/verification/audit cycles. A maximum budget, never an exact count; verified completion may terminate the campaign early.

max_checkpoints.description: Maximum number of coherent task checkpoints (committed task completions) the campaign may produce.

max_wall_seconds.description: Wall-clock budget in seconds, enforced by the existing campaign-timeout authority. A finite positive number.

max_task_attempts.description: Per-task attempt budget, enforced by the existing task-resource-budget authority.

audit_interval.description: Coherent-checkpoint interval at which the independent tester/auditor run (milestone-boundary roles, not mandatory after every patch).

items.description: A repository-relative path prefix (no leading slash, no empty/`.`/`..` segment, no glob characters).

security_sensitive_paths.description: Trusted closed-config path prefixes that force an independent audit when a checkpoint touches them. Never model prose.

mandatory_audit_objectives.description: Audit objective IDs that must all be covered before release success, regardless of checkpoint count.

no_progress_limit.description: Number of consecutive audits that reproduce the same progress fingerprint before the campaign terminates honestly as `no_progress`.
